page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. It has a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps and does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no graphics processing units (GPUs) bundled with this configuration, making it reliant entirely on the host CPU for all computational tasks.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention from other tenants, which represents a distinct hardware class advantage over shared-core instances. However, the 1:2 CPU-to-RAM ratio limits its utility for memory-intensive applications. This configuration is structured for compute-focused workloads with low memory footprints, such as lightweight web serving, microservices, and dedicated application nodes.
